summary: Tested the Xoala compliance changes. All checks passed. The /privacy-policy, /shipping-policy and /refund-policy pages each render with their data-testid, an H1 and a 'Last updated' line. The shipping page shows £4.99 flat and free over £50.00, taken from /api/settings. The links between policy pages work. Footer links footer-privacy-link, footer-shipping-link and footer-refund-link go to the right pages. /terms links to the refund, shipping and privacy policies and no longer says 'All sales are final'. End-to-end checkout run: added a product, filled a UK address with test@example.com, clicked Continue to payment and order GHP-044 was created. The compliance label links to /terms, /refund-policy, /shipping-policy and /privacy-policy. wallid-pay-btn and xoala-pay-btn are disabled until the checkbox is ticked and enabled after. The bank transfer panel is also gated by the checkbox. billing-descriptor-note reads 'This charge will appear on your card statement as GHP-HEALTH'. No pay buttons were clicked. The sitemap includes all three new pages. Home, product and /research-use-policy pages still render. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx: the compliance checkbox, the Xoala card section and billing-descriptor-note are all rendered inside the wallidConfig?.configured block. If Wallid is ever turned off or unconfigured, the policy-acceptance checkbox and the card button with its descriptor disappear, and the acquirer requirement would no longer be met. Move the checkbox and the Xoala section outside the Wallid condition.
Terms.jsx uses plain <a href> for its internal policy links, which reloads the whole page. Use react-router <Link> to match the other pages (minor).
Checkout shipping-address inputs have no data-testid attributes, so tests have to select them by position (minor testability gap).
seed_data_creation: Created test order 34dff037-9f6d-4c76-87fe-361464d67c74 (GHP-044, email test@example.com) during the checkout test and then deleted it with admin DELETE /api/orders/{id}, which returned 200. payments_paused was not changed and is still false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Age gate: tick both checkboxes in [role=dialog], then click ENTER SITE. Checkout shipping inputs have no testids: fill #email, then '#details-form input[required]' at positions 1-6 (first name, last name, address, city, postcode, phone). Product used: /product/10-x-1ml-05-inch-unisharp (in stock).
